chunks: Reclining on green cushions and rich carpets excellent.

key_terms.رَفْرَفٍ: Cushions or pillows, often pluralized to indicate abundance or variety
key_terms.عَبْقَرِيٍّ: Rich, fine, or excellent quality (often referring to textiles or carpets)
key_terms.مُتَّكِئِينَ: Reclining or leaning back in a relaxed posture

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the comfort and furnishings of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rahman is often interpreted through the lens of *Tafsir al-Mizan* and *Tafsir al-Majma'*, where 'green cushions' (*rafraf*) symbolize the freshness and imperishability of divine grace, contrasting with the decay of worldly life. The term *abqari* (fine silk) is understood not merely as material luxury but as a reflection of the refined spiritual state of the *Ahl al-Bayt* and the righteous who attain proximity to God. This description serves to affirm the bodily resurrection (*Jism*) and the continuity of sensory pleasure in the afterlife, a key tenet in Shia theology against those who deny physical recompense.
